name: Level Up
description: Six subjects, each a ladder of levels from kindergarten to 4th grade: reading, math, color science, patterns, time and money, shapes and fractions.

about.concept: Mastery in small steps across six subjects. Each subject is a ladder of levels; a level is passed by getting a run of answers right, so the child always works at the edge of what they know.
about.progression: Ladders run from kindergarten to fourth grade in reading, math, color science, patterns, time and money, and shapes and fractions. The child sees the next rung and what it needs.
lifeSkills: Seeing progress as a series of steps
